resign.zip.what: artefact content edited in artefacts.json and re-signed with a new key

forged_attestation.zip.what: artefacts.json marks an unattested artefact as attested

downgrade.zip.what: an artefact signature replaced by the legacy marker, chain rehashed

truncate.zip.what: entries at and below an anchored seq removed

rehash.zip.what: one payload edited and every later hash recomputed

faketsa.zip.what: rehashed, anchors moved to the new head with random tokens holding the imprint

unpinned_tsa.zip.what: rehashed and re-anchored by the operator's own timestamp authorities

pipe_collision.zip.what: field boundary moved across a '|', which kept the scheme-1 hash

noncanonical.zip.what: a payload re-serialised with whitespace (same values)

hidden_artefact.zip.what: an in-scope artefact removed from artefacts.json and from the filter

anchor_downgrade.zip.what: the external anchor relabelled local and its tokens dropped

gap_register_edit.zip.what: a gap register row marked assigned without a gap.assigned entry

user_signature_forged.zip.what: a user-signed statement re-signed with a key the ledger never registered

user_statement_edit.zip.what: a user-signed capture's title and statement edited, chain rehashed

platform_after_retirement.zip.what: a user-signed capture re-signed with a retired platform key
